# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
# FIX: Use an in-source build with an explicit --prefix to ensure libraries and headers
# are installed correctly to standard system paths, resolving previous linker errors.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
# Explicitly set the installation PREFIX to ensure mfem is installed to a system path for the Laghos build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install PREFIX=/usr/local

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
# FIX: Use an in-source build with an explicit --prefix to ensure libraries and headers
# are installed correctly to standard system paths, resolving previous linker errors.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
# Explicitly set the installation PREFIX to ensure mfem is installed to a system path for the Laghos build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install PREFIX=/usr/local

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1
